label: REPEATED / CONCATENATED DEMO FOOTAGE - load and duration testing only
construction: ffmpeg -f concat -safe 0 -i demo/derived/cam01-repeat33.concat.txt -c copy -movflags +faststart demo/derived/cam01-repeat33.mp4 (stream copy, no re-encode; ffmpeg 9.0 Gyan build)
timestamps: Decoded frame PTS strictly increasing over all 23430 frames (checked with ffprobe frame=pts_time); each join step is 0.043 s instead of 0.033 s, below the backend's 2 s source-discontinuity threshold, so the whole file is one source segment.
limitations: The same 23.7 s of footage repeats 33 times: content, crowd, and detector load are periodic, not a 13-minute real scene.
Not independent footage, not a distinct camera, not usable for accuracy, counting, or facility claims.
A moving handheld camera: no fixed boundary, no calibration.
